features.title: A boilerplate that already feels like product

features.uiDesc: 50+ accessible components, dark mode and CSS-variable theming.
features.rolesDesc: RBAC matrix with “view as” preview to audit every role.
features.themeDesc: Protected layout, org onboarding and working starter panel.

how.title: From boilerplate to SaaS in 3 steps
how.subtitle: The flow you'd follow to turn this demo into your product.
how.step1Desc: Change the name, logo and colors. Auth and DB keep working.
how.step2Desc: Edit strings in packages/lib/src/messages/en.json and es.json. Everything is i18n from the start.
how.step3Desc: Connect your domain, add your real pricing and open public signup.

testimonials.subtitle: Fictional sample testimonials to showcase the design.
testimonials.q1: We cloned the boilerplate on Friday and by Monday we had landing, auth and payments on staging.
testimonials.q2: Type-safe i18n saved us weeks. Breaking a translation breaks the build, not production.
testimonials.q3: The roles matrix with “view as” is gold for selling to enterprise with no extra effort.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Generic answers you can replace with your SaaS ones.
faq.a1: No. It's a boilerplate demo landing to showcase layout, i18n and Shadcn components.
faq.a2: Next.js 16, Better Auth, Prisma, tRPC, next-intl with ES/EN, Shadcn/ui and roles & permissions matrix.
faq.q3: How do I customize the copy?
faq.a3: Edit packages/lib/src/messages/en.json and es.json under the Landing namespace. Build checks parity.
faq.q4: Can I use another color palette?
faq.a4: Yes. Change the CSS variables in the lib package globals.css and the whole theme updates.
faq.q5: How do I add my real pricing?
faq.a5: Replace the pricing section cards and plug in your favorite payment provider.

cta.title: Ready to turn this demo into your SaaS?
cta.subtitle: Copy this route, change the copy and deploy. You already have auth, orgs, i18n and dashboard.
